title: Foodborne investigation project tour
description: Review the imported line list, open its saved command tour, run the visible source, and inspect the audit history.
prerequisite: Import the Foodborne Outbreak Investigation example project. Its 96 synthetic records and saved programs are included.

steps.title: Review the line list
steps.instruction: Confirm that the imported project contains 96 synthetic foodborne investigation records. No analysis has run automatically.

steps.title: Open Classic Analysis
steps.instruction: Choose Classic Analysis from the left module rail. The project data and saved programs remain active.

steps.title: Open a saved program
steps.instruction: Select Open Pgm to see programs carried by this project package.

steps.title: Choose the command tour
steps.instruction: Choose foodborne-classic-command-tour. Review its source before opening it.

steps.title: Load visible source
steps.instruction: Select Open. Loading a program never executes it.

steps.title: Verify the program
steps.instruction: Select Verify Program and review the typed syntax result.

steps.title: Run the reviewed commands
steps.instruction: Select Run Commands only after reviewing the visible source. The output remains auditable in this browser.

steps.title: Inspect command history
steps.instruction: Open History to inspect command source, status, versions, and result summaries.
